remarks: This rental is located in a quiet walkable neighborhood. It is a spacious and bright upstairs two bedroom, one bath unit in two family house. Freshly fully painted with new appliances. Close to shopping, restaurants. Train and school are less than 1 mile away. If you don't like to cook this is the place for you. Lots of variety for meals is within walking distance.  The landlord is requesting a FICO score of 680 or higher. The landlord will take a pet up to 20LB. but not bigger. The landlord is paying for grounds care, water, garbage and snow removal. the tenant is responsible for gas, electricity, Liability insurance and rentspree application fee. Two months deposit and first months rent are payable at contract signing. Rentspree link: https://apply.link/LqF85dU
